text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, ever since coming to Tracen 
Academy, racing has become so much more 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There are many strong Umamusume here, so 
winning every time isn't guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Sometimes, 1st place can feel so far 
away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, that's precisely why finishing in 
first place feels so much more thrilling 
than before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Winning is fun. That's why I want to win 
more. ...I want to win this race too, 
Trainer."

Though her demeanor remained quiet and 
dispassionate as usual, I could feel her 
fierce determination behind those words.
